interface.longDescription: ChatGPT adaptation of Lauren Tan’s MIT-licensed pstack. Includes engineering review, verification, and writing skills plus native workflows for GitHub PR review, bounded continuation, issue intake and reproduction, subagents, model roles, project defaults, and recall. Live automations and external writes require configured connections and user authorization.

name: pstack
description: Engineering workflows for investigation, code review, verification, and technical writing.
